description.text: Energy-label technical properties (EU 2019/2014), sourced from EPREL.
EU energy-label class A-G (EEIW). Source: EPREL.
kWh per 100 cycles (eco 40-60). Source: EPREL.
Litres per cycle. Source: EPREL.
Spin-drying class A-G. Source: EPREL.
Maximum spin speed (rpm). Source: EPREL. provisional semanticId; real ECLASS IRDI TBD.
Remaining moisture content (percent). Source: EPREL.
Programme duration eco 40-60 (minutes). Source: EPREL.
Airborne noise dB(A) + class A-D. Source: EPREL.
Rated capacity (kg). Source: EPREL.
Declared design lifetime (cycles / years). ESPR durability.
Repair-ease index (0-10). ESPR / FR index.
Years parts stay available and/or SKU list. ESPR.
Recycled content (percent). ESPR.
Recyclability (percent). ESPR.
Ease of hardware/software upgrade (index 0-10). ESPR. Custom.
Accessibility to proprietary hardware/software required for maintenance. ESPR. Custom.
Share of components separable for repair/recycling, percent (disassembly). ESPR. Custom.
Share of standardized (non-proprietary) components, percent. ESPR. Custom.
Provisional circularity collection (no published IDTA template yet); provisional project semanticIds. Lift to a standalone submodel when a standard is published.
Reliability characteristics per IDTA 02013-1-0 (IEC 62683), plus custom extensions (MTTR, failure rate, R(t), availability) needed for the PSS service-level KPIs.
Number of reliability characteristic sets.
Useful life in wash cycles.
Useful life in hours.
Electrical operating-condition properties omitted: not applicable to a domestic washer.
Mean operating time to failure.
Mean operating time between failures.
Operations at which 10% of units have failed.
Mean time to repair (hours). Custom - not in IDTA 02013.
Failure rate lambda (1/h). Custom.
Survival probability R(t) at a reference time (0-1). Custom - derived.
A = MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR), percent. Custom - derived.
Custom extensions beyond IDTA 02013, under the electrolux project namespace.

Custom submodel for the Product-Service-System (PSS) offered around the asset: service configuration, operational health data, and a maintenance-request operation. No published IDTA template covers PSS, so semanticIds are project-defined under the electrolux/washer namespace.
Current predictive health score of the asset (0-100).
Reference to a time-series submodel holding raw IoT data, populated at instance level.
Lifetime wash-cycle counter.
Measured energy per cycle vs rated (kWh/cycle).
Residual value / refurbish-worthiness (currency or score).
Cycles per week; normalises RUL and energy metrics.
SLA compliance (percent).
First-time fix rate (percent).
Mean time to acknowledge / respond (hours).
Number of service interventions (count).
Total cost of ownership per cycle (currency).
Customer satisfaction / NPS score.
Total accumulated machine operating time (hours); complements the cycle counter. Custom - no standard IRDI.
Commercial warranty coverage period / remaining. Custom.
Legally guaranteed minimum lifespan (distinct from declared technical lifetime; ESPR). Custom.
Reference to maintenance and safety-check records gathered under ELX-4. Custom.
Which product types/units are eligible for the PSS offer. Custom.

Chronological list of field service interventions on this asset instance. One entry per service call. Custom: no published IDTA template covers field service records, so semanticIds are project-defined under the electrolux/washer namespace. Source: Electrolux service database (field repair extract).
